name: gameheritage
title: Video game digital heritage: historical structures in games and real life

licenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
licenses.title: Metadata and project-written text; third-party images and Wikipedia text keep their own licenses (see credits.csv)

fields.name: game_id
fields.description: Identifier of the game (lowercase slug), e.g. 'assassins-creed-unity'

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the game

fields.name: series
fields.description: Series or franchise

fields.name: edition_note
fields.description: Editions or expansions merged into this row

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Year of first release

fields.name: developer
fields.description: Developer(s), from Wikidata

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Publisher(s), from Wikidata

fields.name: genre
fields.description: Genre(s), from Wikidata

fields.name: depicted_period_start
fields.description: First year of the historical period the game is set in

fields.description: Last year of the historical period the game is set in

fields.name: depicted_regions
fields.description: Regions or countries the game is set in

fields.description: Wikidata item of the game

fields.description: English Wikipedia article of the game

fields.description: The game's Fandom wiki, where most game images come from

fields.description: Where the game facts come from, with retrieval date

fields.description: Curators' notes

fields.name: site_id

fields.description: Name of the place (English label on Wikidata)

fields.name: alt_names
fields.description: Other names, separated by semicolons

fields.description: Wikidata item of the place

fields.description: Project category (building, monument, ...); often empty, see wikidata_type

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country, from Wikidata

fields.name: locality
fields.description: City or area the place is in, from Wikidata

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude (WGS84), from Wikidata

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude (WGS84), from Wikidata

fields.name: construction_date
fields.description: Year built, founded or first recorded; negative for BCE

fields.description: Which date that is and where it comes from (e.g. 'Wikidata, inception'; 'description text (approximate)')

fields.name: historical_period

fields.name: architectural_style
fields.description: Architectural style(s), from Wikidata

fields.description: Wikimedia Commons category of the place

fields.name: wikipedia_url
fields.description: English Wikipedia article of the place

fields.name: description
fields.description: Opening sentences of the Wikipedia article (or Wikidata description)

fields.name: description_source
fields.description: Source page of the description

fields.name: description_license
fields.description: License of the description text (Wikipedia: CC BY-SA 4.0)

fields.name: facts_source
fields.description: Where the place facts come from, with retrieval date

fields.description: Curation status of the place: todo (not yet reviewed), keep, drop

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Curators' notes; 'type: ...' gives the Wikidata type

fields.description: What Wikidata says the place is (instance of), e.g. 'cathedral'

fields.name: year
fields.description: Year the place was built or founded; negative for BCE

fields.name: century
fields.description: Century of that year, e.g. '12th century', '26th century BCE'

fields.name: era
fields.description: Historical era used on the website (Prehistory ... 20th century)

fields.name: web_page
fields.description: The place's page on the project website

fields.description: Identifier: '<game_id>--<place slug>'

fields.name: game_id
fields.description: The game (games.game_id)

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: The real place (sites.site_id)

fields.name: in_game_name
fields.description: Name of the place in the game or on its wiki

fields.name: period_in_game
fields.description: Period in which the game shows the place, when recorded

fields.name: depiction_class
fields.description: 1 = the game names the real place; 2 = inspired by it

fields.description: How the match was made, e.g. an automatic Wikidata match and its score

fields.name: basis_source
fields.description: Evidence for the match (Wikidata item or reference)

fields.name: in_game_description
fields.description: Opening of the place's page on the game's Fandom wiki

fields.name: in_game_description_source
fields.description: Source page of the in-game description

fields.name: in_game_description_license
fields.description: License of the in-game description (Fandom: CC BY-SA 3.0)

fields.name: review_status
fields.description: keep = reviewed by the project; todo = automatic, not yet reviewed

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Curators' notes

fields.name: verified
fields.description: True when a project member reviewed the match

fields.name: web_page
fields.description: The real place's page on the project website

fields.name: image_id
fields.description: Identifier of the image ('gh-' + hash)

fields.name: role
fields.description: 'game' (in-game image) or 'real' (photograph or picture of the real place)

fields.description: Game the image comes from (game images)

fields.name: depiction_id
fields.description: In-game version the image shows (game images)

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Real place the image shows

fields.name: kind
fields.description: screenshot, concept_art, render, modern_photo, historical_photo, ...

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the image (file page title or the collector's name for it)

fields.name: in_game_place
fields.description: Place name the collector or wiki gives the image

fields.name: original_filename
fields.description: File name at the source

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the original file, for de-duplication and integrity checks

fields.name: phash
fields.description: Perceptual hash of the original file, for near-duplicate detection

fields.name: width
fields.description: Width of the original file in pixels

fields.name: height
fields.description: Height of the original file in pixels

fields.name: true_format
fields.description: Format of the original file as read from its bytes (jpeg, png, webp...)

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: Size of the original file in bytes

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: Where the image comes from, e.g. 'Wikimedia Commons' or a Fandom wiki

fields.name: source_page_url
fields.description: The image's page at the source (file page with author and license)

fields.name: file_url
fields.description: Direct link to the original file at the source

fields.name: author
fields.description: Author or uploader

fields.name: license
fields.description: License, e.g. 'CC BY-SA 4.0', 'Public domain'; empty for game assets

fields.name: license_url
fields.description: Link to the license

fields.name: attribution_required
fields.description: Whether the license requires attribution

fields.name: collected_by
fields.description: Who collected the image (a project member or the project's scripts)

fields.name: collection_method
fields.description: How the image was collected

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.description: Date the image was retrieved

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Problems found by the checks (duplicates, wrong format, ...)

fields.name: review_status
fields.description: keep, todo (not yet reviewed) or drop

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Curators' notes

fields.description: Width of the web copy in pixels

fields.name: web_height
fields.description: Height of the web copy in pixels

fields.description: Identifier of the pair

fields.description: In-game version compared (depictions.depiction_id)

fields.name: game_image_id
fields.description: Game image (images.image_id)

fields.name: real_image_id
fields.description: Real image (images.image_id)

fields.description: same_structure_same_view, same_structure_other_view, same_site_other_part or style_analogue, when reviewed

fields.description: Who made or reviewed the pair
